annotations.title: Move a whole app, one step at a time

description: Walks a non-technical owner through the whole move of a Bubble® app to their own Cloudflare account as a checklist that is saved on the job: free audit and plan, a secure page for tokens (never typed in chat), the app file upload, the move score, a free preview, optional extras, the exact price, payment, the data move, the backend and pages, the deploy, the checks, and the go-live step. Start with app_base_url, or carry on with job_id: every call says where the job is, what happens next and what, if anything, the owner must do, in plain words. It stops only for things the owner must do (tokens, the file, choosing extras, confirming the price and paying, the go-live switch), or for work still running (call it again), and it carries on after any failure or top-up with nothing repeated. Nothing is charged to start: credits are taken only for each part that was built and passed its automatic check, and a part that fails is not charged or is refunded. If the move score is too low it says so before any money and offers the studio's done-for-you service as an option, never a requirement. Going live is a short wizard (result.go_live, the same screens as the editor): a free address at once, or the owner's own domain, which it connects when the domain is already on Cloudflare in the same account, or moves to Cloudflare (free) after copying the email and other records, then waits for the two nameservers, attaches the domain, checks the padlock and that the app answers, and records the go-live by itself. It changes DNS only when the owner chooses an action, only with the owner's own saved token, never touches the old app, and the owner can switch back for 30 days. How the build works: paid builds use Claude Sonnet for every page, and any page still under the pass mark gets a retry round from the stronger Claude Opus 5.5. Paying starts the full build straight away. The Cloudflare and R2 details are asked right after payment and never hold the build up; only the data move, the deploy and the export wait for verified details. Service keys (Stripe, Google sign-in, email and similar) are optional: they can be added any time after the build, even once the app is live in Cloudflare, and any service can be left off. Some moved apps need small touch-ups, because translating visual workflows and plugins is never word for word, so say so honestly. After the move the owner can keep improving the app with their own AI coding agent (Claude Code, Antigravity and similar): a paid build comes with a ready polish prompt, also in the delivered README. Work is saved for 30 days from the last activity on a paid move (7 days for a free preview). The editor shows an estimate of when the build will be ready, and the owner is emailed when it is ready or when action is needed.

add_ons.description: Extras to switch on (their ids from the list shown at the choose-extras step).

app_base_url.description: Start a new move for this app address, for example https://yourapp.bubbleapps.io. Not needed with job_id.

app_spec.description: app-spec.json from the audit plugin, instead of uploading the catalog.

close_job.description: After go-live: delete the tokens saved for this job and close it.

confirm_add_ons.description: The owner has chosen their extras (or none) and is ready to see the exact price.

confirm_go_live.description: The owner made the address switch by hand, without the wizard. Records the go-live.

confirm_price_usd.description: The exact total in USD, as shown, once the owner has agreed to it. If the total changed since, the call says so and charges nothing.

domain.description: The owner's domain for going live, for example example.com (with go_live_action domain).

go_live_action.description: One step of the go-live wizard, as offered in result.go_live.actions: domain (with domain, and subdomain: true for one like app.example.com), free (the app's own address, live at once), connect, move_dns, nameservers_done, check, retry (after the token is updated), back (change domain), not_yet, switch_back (within 30 days, ask the owner first), add_domain.

job_id.description: Carry on with this move (the job_id from the first call).

job_secret.description: The job_secret returned when this job was made (or the job's signed editor link). Required with job_id when no API key is sent: the job_id alone does not open a job.

new_link.description: Make a fresh secure link even if the last one is still valid (for example when it was lost).

pages_ok.description: The owner has looked at the built pages and wants to go on (asked only when the server is set to stop for a look).

preview_add_ons.description: Extras whose demo is built by the model from the preview pages: mobile, ai_assistant, or the id of a described change. Each extra can be tried twice and an app six times in all; the tries are free.

rebuild_pages.description: Pages that are not right, each with a short note that goes to the builder as extra instructions. Notes made before the full build are used when it starts; notes on the built pages cause up to 2 rebuilds per page, free.

note.description: A few words: what is not right on that page.

sitemap_url.description: The old app's sitemap, for the redirect list at the go-live step. Default: the app's own /sitemap.xml.

subdomain.description: With go_live_action domain: the owner wants a subdomain such as app.example.com.

version.description: Which database to read when starting. Default live.
